units.source_text: 他来到东宫时，藤壶皇后尚未退出。

en.t: When he arrived at the Crown Prince's palace, Empress Fujitsubo had not yet withdrawn.

units.source_text: 他就托侍女转达：“刻因参见陛下，故至此夜深时方来请安。”

en.t: He therefore asked a lady-in-waiting to convey his message: "I was attending upon His Majesty, and so have only now come to pay my respects at this late hour."
At that moment the moonlight was very beautiful.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后听见源氏大将来了，便想起桐壶院在世时情状：

en.t: When Empress Fujitsubo heard that General Genji had come, she remembered how things had been while the Kiritsubo Emperor was still alive:

units.source_text: 当时每逢如此良宵，必有丝竹管弦之兴，何等繁荣热闹！

en.t: In those days, whenever there was such a fine night, there would always be the delight of music from strings and flutes; how splendid and lively it had been!

units.source_text: 如今宫殿依然不改，而人事变态实多，可胜叹哉！

en.t: Now the palace remained unchanged, yet human affairs had altered so greatly that one could hardly help lamenting.

units.source_text: 便即景吟诗，命王命妇传告源氏大将：

en.t: Thereupon, moved by the scene before her, she composed a poem and ordered Omyobu to deliver it to General Genji:
